title: SS27 Women's Celebrity Influence
summary: The 2026 red carpets previewed SS27: sheer gowns, strong colour, dark romance, '90s white minimalism and feathers. This is how those looks reach the SS27 customer.

sections.heading: What the red carpet showed
sections.body:
At Cannes in May 2026, NET-A-PORTER's editors identified five red-carpet trends<sup>[1]</sup>:

- **Sheer beauty.** Despite the festival's dress code, Natasha Poly wore a see-through georgette and pleated satin Ferragamo gown, and Chloé Zhao a pointelle-knit gown from Gabriela Hearst<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Colour confidence.** Demi Moore wore custom red and lilac Gucci, and Simone Ashley and Isabelle Huppert wore vintage red McQueen and Gucci<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Dark romance.** Black gowns with ruffles, velvet and lace on Ruth Negga, Cate Blanchett and Cara and Poppy Delevingne; Negga's custom Saint Laurent combined a guipure lace bodice with a tulle peplum<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **'90s minimalism.** Pristine white gowns with clean, minimal shapes<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Feathers.** Some of the most talked-about looks of the festival<sup>[1]</sup>.

At Paris Haute Couture Week in July, Demi Moore and Cynthia Erivo attended Pierpaolo Piccioli's Balenciaga debut, which closed with Gigi Hadid<sup>[2]</sup>.

sections.heading: How it connects to SS27
sections.body: Each red-carpet trend has a direct SS27 runway counterpart: sheer gowns and the sheer suits of Dior and Louis Vuitton<sup>[3]</sup>; red and lilac and the season's purple and primary blocks<sup>[4]</sup>; dark romance and the dark lace of Première Vision's decoration report<sup>[5]</sup>; white minimalism and the rise of white to 28.4% of SS27 looks<sup>[6]</sup>. Red-carpet exposure months before delivery is why these ideas are likely to sell when they reach stores in spring 2027 (Forecut assessment).

sections.heading: Looks to build
sections.body:
- **The sheer column:** a sheer knit or georgette column dress over a slip, with flat sandals for day.
- **Red head to toe:** a red satin skirt with a red knit or shirt.
- **Lilac evening:** a lilac satin slip dress with a cropped jacket.
- **White minimal:** a white bias-cut dress or a white suit with no visible trims.
- **Dark romance for day:** a black lace-trimmed slip skirt with a white shirt.

design_implications:
- Translate red-carpet ideas into day weights: georgette and fine knit instead of beaded tulle.
- Keep the celebrity idea in one element (colour, sheerness, lace) and simplify the rest.
commercial_implications:
- Time marketing to the 2027 awards and festival calendar, when the same ideas return to the red carpet.
- Sheer and occasion pieces sell close to events; plan smaller, later deliveries for them.
- Avoid licensing or naming celebrities in product marketing without agreements.
